notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.notes:
The new update includes gamepad compatibility!! You can now play only with a game controller (see user's manual for more information). 

New adds also include: 
- item discovery statistics in the menu,
- secret thoughts discovery statistics in the menu,
- item detection shows red light for item Alternated Mansion.

Before you update to the new version, make sure you completed your current game, because you will have to start a new one. However, if you have a completed save file, you can use it to start a New Game +.

notes.title: Major update
notes.notes:
To respond to the first feedbacks from the player, the game has benefited a major update to improve the game.

Ten days after its launch, the game received many good feedbacks, but many players also complained about the difficulty, the lack of guidance and some problems of visibility. To respond to these feedback and offer a better gaming experience, the game has been updated with these majors changes:


- more resources at the beginning of the adventure (ink pots and medications) so it is more easy to save and heal.

- limit the overall maximum obscurity and the minimum of light the player can reach, so it’s always possible to see the surrounding.

- add more guidance and indications in the texts.

- display help messages in the map menu to help the player in the main quest (see joined pictures).
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27092660/e8de1b2a41e58d748c31550a27e0faa9c258dff4.jpg http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27092660/c1f44999008bd26f92729624b65eb34b3f649e40.jpg
 

The last point is the major improvement. Now, during the main path, help messages and symbols are displayed on the map so it is more easy to know what to do next.  


Hopefully the game will be more enjoyable by everyone!
Some guides are available also on the Steam Page for the first parts of the main path.
